artifacts.summary: 3-phase documentation-only plan: convention stated once at Component 7, pointer-only note at conclusion-stage.md Overview, redeploy plus full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: suite_selection_select (scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh) invoked with MULTIPLE paths at once collapses to the bare __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel as soon as ANY one path is unmapped, hiding the real suites the other paths map to. Measured: the two paths docs/reference/standards/multi-task-creation-standard.md (unmapped) and context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md (mapped to test-orchestrate-conclusion-{aggregate,backstop,roadmap}.sh) return __FULL_SWEEP__ together, but the real three suites when the second path is queried alone. When authoring a per-phase Tier Justification, always invoke the selector once per phase with that phase's own paths only -- a combined run produces a false sentinel claim that validate-artifact.sh will reject.
